comparison.objective: Candidate finishes inserts by breaking and collecting tangs; record opens a sealed desiccator and removes a sample vial.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires narrow-tool alignment, controlled hammer impact, and tiny-fragment search; record requires seal/lid manipulation, careful sample extraction, and lid placement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four contained fractures and an undamaged shell/coil assembly; record requires vial placement on a tray, lid on a pad, and an unmoved desiccator, with no further specs.
comparison.reason: Opening a sealed vessel and transporting a sample does not test manufactured-notch fracture or insert retention.
